name: Silent Victory x Let's Wrassle Premium T-Shirt
description:
Two brands. One mindset. Built for war, forged in silence.
This collab between Let's Wrassle, Co. and Silent Victory Training Center brings together the raw tenacity of the wrestling mat and the no-excuses mentality of the training grind.
On the front, a fierce bulldog illustration sits at the center of a circular battle mantra:
"SILENT VICTORY TC – FORGED IN SILENCE | BUILT FOR WAR"
A symbol of unshakable grit, unspoken discipline, and fight-over-flash mentality.
On the back, the vertical Let's Wrassle mark in bold black and pink hits loud and unapologetic—just like your presence when you walk into the room or step on the mat.

Material: 52% cotton / 48% polyester
Color: Cement / Off White
Fit: True to Size / Athletic Fit
